ruleDefinitions.name: PowerShell Script With File Upload Capabilities
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects PowerShell scripts leveraging the "Invoke-WebRequest" cmdlet to send data via either "PUT" or "POST" method. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Invoke\\-RestMethod.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Invoke\\-WebRequest.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*irm\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*iwr\\ .*")) AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Method\\ \\"POST\\.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Method\\ \\"PUT\\.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Method\\ POST.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Method\\ PUT.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Method\\ \\'POST\\.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Method\\ \\'PUT\\.*")))
